;Law and crime
*[[Arrests of Wa Lone and Kyaw Soe Oo]]
**Two [[Reuters]] journalists jailed in [[Myanmar]] are sentenced to seven years in prison for violating the Official Secrets Act, prompting international condemnation. The pair was investigating reports of mass graves at the village of [[Inn Din]] when they were arrested in [[Yangon]] for attempting to obtain classified documents, which they contend were used as bait to [[Entrapment|entrap]] them. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/sep/03/myanmar-reuters-journalists-sentenced-to-seven-years-in-prison-rohingya (''The Guardian'')]
